models_evaluated: Epic Early Detection of Sepsis Model version 2 (locally trained gradient-boosted tree ensemble)

links.outcome: Positive predictive value and lead time at model score thresholds (alert burden from false positives)
links.effect: At the Sepsis-3 Youden threshold (score 9), PPV was 11.4% with median lead time 3.4 h; PPV was 6.8% for SEP-1 and 5.9% for ASE. AUPRC was 0.11-0.24.
links.quote: Although the model provided some advance warning before sepsis onset, a high false-positive rate may limit its clinical utility without careful threshold selection and tailored implementation.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating sepsis prediction model performance against multiple standard sepsis outcome definitions (Sepsis-3, SEP-1, ASE)

screen.reason: Evaluates the predictive performance and lead time of a locally trained sepsis prediction model (Epic Sepsis Model v2) during silent deployment across 9 hospitals against multiple standard sepsis definitions.
